upstream_basis.installed_behavior: PyTorch v2.12 Windows subprocess decoding is strict and fatal on encoding mismatch.
upstream_basis.upstream_behavior: PyTorch v2.13 adds errors='replace' to Windows subprocess decoding.

objective: Determine whether one process-local compatibility shim that exactly mirrors the official PyTorch v2.13 Windows decoder behavior is sufficient for the installed PyTorch 2.12 stack to generate and dependency-audit one deterministic CPU AOTInductor package, without loading the package or installing dependencies.
hypothesis: The previous protected package attempt failed only because installed v2.12 decoded UTF-8 MSVC help output with a strict CP936 decoder. Applying the upstream v2.13 errors='replace' behavior before any compiler probe will pass the exact failing preflight and allow package generation to reach the next factual gate.

options_considered.selected: One isolated default-locale worker plus a process-local PyTorch v2.13-compatible SUBPROCESS_DECODE_ARGS=(locale.getpreferredencoding(), replace) shim, with installed files unchanged.
options_considered.rejected_python_utf8_only: -X utf8 aligns the observed compiler output but changes process-wide text, file, stdio, and subprocess defaults; it is a useful decode control, not the narrow package branch.
options_considered.rejected_cp936_only: Avoiding code-page 65001 makes environment capture locale-dependent and is less reproducible across Windows hosts.
options_considered.production_destination: Qualify an actual PyTorch v2.13+ runtime after the synthetic compatibility experiment; do not ship the shim as a permanent private fork.

scope.tiny_model: Reuse only the implementation-manifest-bound deterministic Linear -> exact GELU -> TopK CPU model constructor. Generate a new input from successor-owned constants whose SHA differs from the old partial input, under a fresh loop-specific tiny_v2 attempt root.
scope.preflight: Launch an isolated default-locale worker from a generated batch file limited to a pre-assignment gate, vcvars activation, and pre-import environment setup. The controller creates a Windows KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE Job Object, launches the gated cmd child, assigns it before releasing job_assigned.flag, and proves zero active processes before closing the handle. The controller also owns console code pages through a WinAPI try/finally boundary that captures the prior values, sets input/output to UTF-8 around the child, and restores the exact prior values. Reproduce the exact cl.exe help bytes, verify strict CP936 failure, apply the in-memory upstream shim, and prove replacement decode plus _is_msvc_cl/get_cpp_compiler complete with CUDA uninitialized.
scope.package: After a new implementation manifest, package authorization, and single-use lease, execute one model construction, one torch.export, and one aoti_compile_and_package call.
scope.post_package: Audit archive safety, exactly one precompiled .pyd, retained size, CUDA state, and dumpbin dependencies. Stop before any Python or C++ package load.

static_governance.official_source_contract: Bind the official v2.13.0 tag, commit, cpp_builder.py payload SHA, normalized SUBPROCESS_DECODE_ARGS excerpt SHA, and issue 157673 without protected-stage network access.
static_governance.reuse_authority_boundary: Only the two frozen C++ binary bytes may be reused by hash; no parent authorization, ready lease, or consumed lease transfers authority.
